notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.
